description: Washington State Department of Licensing registered electric vehicles (BEV and plug-in hybrid): make, model, model year, EV type, electric range, city, county and ZIP. Vehicles are registrations, not current status; the range field is 0 where not yet researched. Related tools on this server, for a different need: travel_carsdirect_vehicle when you need CarsDirect used-car listings near a US ZIP code: vehicle; travel_fipe_brazil_vehicle_prices when you need Brazilian FIPE reference price for one car: brand, model. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
